```{r}
      round(stress_data_long[[i]]$age14 - stress_data_long[[i]]$age12),

      stress_data_long[[i]]$baseline_year == 2006 & stress_data_long[[i]]$WAVEID_N == "2014",
      round(stress_data_long[[i]]$age14 - stress_data_long[[i]]$age10),

      stress_data_long[[i]]$baseline_year == 2008 & stress_data_long[[i]]$WAVEID_N == "2016",
      round(stress_data_long[[i]]$age16 - stress_data_long[[i]]$age12),
```

```{r}
models <- list(
  model1 = model1,
  model2 = model2,
  model3 = model3,
  model4 = model4,
  model5_group0 = model5_group0,
  model5_group1 = model5_group1
)


extract_mi_results <- function(model, model_name) {
  betas <- MIextract(model, fun = fixef)
  vars  <- MIextract(model, fun = vcov)
  vars2 <- list()
  for ( i in 1:40) { vars2[[i]] <- as.matrix(vars[[i]])  }
  c <- MIcombine(betas, vars2, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)
  sum_c <- summary(c)
  
  names(sum_c) <- c("estimate", "std_error", "lower_95", "upper_95", "missInfo")
  
  tStat <- c$coefficients / sqrt(diag(c$variance))
  pVals <- round(2 * pt(-abs(tStat), df = c$df), 3)

  tibble(
    model = model_name,
    term = names(c$coefficients),
    estimate = sum_c$estimate,
    std_error = sum_c$std_error,
    lower_95 = sum_c$lower_95,
    upper_95 = sum_c$upper_95,
    p_value = pVals
  )
}

main_analysis <- imap_dfr(models, extract_mi_results)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(main_analysis, file = "D:/OneDrive - University of Southern California/R00/Manuscripts/HRS/Stress sensitization/Output/main_analysis_model_result.rds")

```


```{r}
keywords <- c("lifetime_experience", "childhood_experience", "aces")

main_analysis_formatted <- main_analysis %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, paste(keywords, collapse = "|"))) %>%
  mutate(
    model = recode(model,
                   "model1" = "1",
                   "model2" = "2",
                   "model3" = "3",
                   "model4" = "4",
                   "model5_group0" = "5 (No childhood adversity)",
                   "model5_group1" = "5 (Experienced childhood adversity)"
    ),
    term = term %>%
      str_replace_all("lifetime_experienceExposed", "Experienced lifetime traumatic events") %>%
      str_replace_all("childhood_experienceExposed", "Experienced childhood adversity") %>%
      str_replace_all("aces", "ACES score") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\btime\\b", "Time"),
    
    Estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    `Lower 95% CI` = round(lower_95, 3),
    `Upper 95% CI` = round(upper_95, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(Model=model, Term=term, Estimate, `Lower 95% CI`, `Upper 95% CI`)



main_analysis_formatted %>%
  flextable() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  set_table_properties(width = 0.7, layout = "autofit") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10) %>%
  line_spacing(i = 1) %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")
```

```{r}
saveRDS(main_analysis_formatted , file = "D:/OneDrive - University of Southern California/R00/Manuscripts/HRS/Stress sensitization/Output/main_analysis_formatted_result.rds")
```

```{r}
models <- list(
  model6 = model6,
  model6_group0 = model6_group0,
  model6_group1 = model6_group1
)


extract_mi_results <- function(model, model_name) {
  betas <- MIextract(model, fun = fixef)
  vars  <- MIextract(model, fun = vcov)
  
  vars2 <- list()
  for (i in 1:40) {
    vars2[[i]] <- as.matrix(vars[[i]])
  }
  
  c <- MIcombine(betas, vars2, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)
  sum_c <- summary(c)
  names(sum_c) <- c("estimate", "std_error", "lower_95", "upper_95", "missInfo")
  
  tStat <- c$coefficients / sqrt(diag(c$variance))
  pVals <- round(2 * pt(-abs(tStat), df = c$df), 3)
  
  tibble(
    model = model_name,
    term = names(c$coefficients),
    estimate = sum_c$estimate,
    std_error = sum_c$std_error,
    lower_95 = sum_c$lower_95,
    upper_95 = sum_c$upper_95,
    p_value = pVals
  )
}


sensitivity_analyses <- imap_dfr(models, extract_mi_results)
```

```{r}
extract_mi_results <- function(model, model_name) {
  betas <- MIextract(model, fun = fixef)
  vars  <- MIextract(model, fun = vcov)
  vars2 <- list()
  for ( i in 1:40) { vars2[[i]] <- as.matrix(vars[[i]])  }
  c <- MIcombine(betas, vars2, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)
  sum_c <- summary(c)
  
  names(sum_c) <- c("estimate", "std_error", "lower_95", "upper_95", "missInfo")
  
  tStat <- c$coefficients / sqrt(diag(c$variance))
  pVals <- round(2 * pt(-abs(tStat), df = c$df), 3)

  tibble(
    model = model_name,
    term = names(c$coefficients),
    estimate = sum_c$estimate,
    std_error = sum_c$std_error,
    lower_95 = sum_c$lower_95,
    upper_95 = sum_c$upper_95,
    p_value = pVals
  )
}

sensitivity_analyses_14_20 <- imap_dfr(models, extract_mi_results)
```

```{r}
vars <- c("child_died", "major_disaster", "fire_weapon", 
          "sp_drugs", "physical_attack", "illness", "life_threatening")


long_results <- final_cohort_aces_clean %>%
  group_by(imp) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(vars),
                   list(
                     n = ~sum(. == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                    pct = ~sum(. == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100
                   ),
                   .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop")


summary_results <- long_results %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean))


n_results <- summary_results %>%
  select(ends_with("_n")) %>%
  rename_with(~gsub("_n", "", .), ends_with("_n"))

pct_results <- summary_results %>%
  select(ends_with("_pct")) %>%
  rename_with(~gsub("_pct", "", .), ends_with("_pct"))


final_table <- tibble(
  Event = names(n_results),
  Mean_N = as.numeric(n_results[1, ]),
  Mean_Percent = round(as.numeric(pct_results[1, ]), 1)
)

final_table
```

```{r}
keywords <- c("Experienced lifetime traumatic events", "Time:Experienced lifetime traumatic events","time")

ace_count_binary_formatted <- ace_count_binary_analysis  %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, paste(keywords, collapse = "|"))) %>%
  mutate(
    model = recode(model,
                   "model21" = "21",
                   "model22" = "22",
                   "model23_group0" = "23 (No childhood adversity)",
                   "model23_group1" = "23 (Experienced childhood adversity)"
    ),
    term = term %>%
      str_replace_all("lifetime_experienceExposed", "Experienced lifetime traumatic events") %>%
      str_replace_all("childhood_experienceExposed", "Experienced childhood adversity") %>%
      str_replace_all("aces", "ACES score") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\btime\\b", "Time"),
    
    Estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    `Lower 95% CI` = round(lower_95, 3),
    `Upper 95% CI` = round(upper_95, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(Model=model, Term=term, Estimate, `Lower 95% CI`, `Upper 95% CI`)



ace_count_binary_formatted %>%
  flextable() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  set_table_properties(width = 0.7, layout = "autofit") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10) %>%
  line_spacing(i = 1) %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")
```
